name: Aoze 1.3.1
bodyHtml:
Aoze 1.3.1: A smoother tutorial, and a Convert page that looks like the rest.

Improved

  • Tutorial: each note now fades out, and the next one fades in right where it belongs once the highlight has reached its element. It no longer appears somewhere else first and jumps.
  • Convert opens on the same drop zone as Image & GIF and Clip, with the four conversions as shortcuts inside it.
  • Help: answers start closed and unfold gently when you click a question.

Fixed

  • Replaying the tutorial while it was open could leave the wrong page behind it.

Download Aoze_1.3.1_x64-setup.exe, run it, done (FFmpeg and every engine are included).
Aoze 1.1.0 and later update themselves: they offer the new version when it is out.
The installer is per-user (no admin rights). It is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen
may show "Windows protected your PC": choose "More info", then "Run anyway".
